digest.component_or_area: plan review gate - operator-attested evidence contract
propositions: Attested evidence currently lacks provenance context (environment, principal, privilege posture, instrument), allowing measurements from wrong environments or under excessive privilege to pass the gate undetected

Two real escapes in run 061c-ecd1-8967-4a76 exploited this gap: caching measurements from account 579718921998/us-east-2 recorded for account 896586841071/us-east-1, and bedrock:Converse calls under bedrock:* privilege offered as proof of a scoped bedrock:InvokeModel grant

The fix extends the [operator-attested] evidence contract with four mandatory provenance fields (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) declared as indented continuation lines under each checkbox item, enforced deterministically for presence and shape without LLM judgment

A deterministic check (det_measurement_provenance.py) validates that all four provenance fields are present, non-placeholder, and (for privilege_posture and instrument) members of their allowed literal sets, surfaced as advisory through p6_ac_quality with no blocking impact on pre-contract tickets

An AGENT-tier criterion (project.measurement-provenance) with tool-enabled agentic execution reads the declared environment against in-repo IaC anchors (Terraform backend), checks privilege_posture against scoped permissions, and validates that authorization claims use live-call not simulation, catching the contradiction-detectable subset of escapes

The new ADR-0061 records the amended evidence contract; the shipped default criteria set remains byte-identical; the contract change applies only to the project overlay, ensuring no cross-client behavior change
